author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Yots, a third-person survival action roguelike developed by Yots Studio. Players will take up arms to defend the cities from hostiles from the fog. Collect artifacts, line up new builds, and do it all in the name of Yots. Yots is coming soon to PC (Steam).

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Reveal Trailer for Potato Please, a first-person potato peeling game developed by Golden Horn Studios. Players will wield a knife, grab a bucket, and peel a literal mountain of potatoes until the army has been fed. Serve your country in Potato Please, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Potato Please - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Wizards in the Sewer announcement trailer for this upcoming FPS magic-mixing roguelite. Solo or co-op, fight wizards and creatures through procedurally generated sewers, forests and dystopian futures — all hand-painted with real paint and paper. Collect seeds for your garden and grow power-ups for your next adventure. The trailer gives a peek at your chaotic FPS adventure without guns, where you mix and match 12 elemental ammo into wands! Wizards In the Sewer will be available on PC in 2027.

#WizardsInTheSewer #Gaming #IGN
title: Wizards In the Sewer - Official Announcement Trailer

description: Don't miss the Gallica Character Trailer for Metaphor: ReFantazio, the hit anime turn-based RPG developed by Atlus. Players can embark on a grand adventure with the fairy companion Gallica, to lend her abilities and expertise along the way. Metaphor: ReFantazio is launching on Nintendo Switch 2 on November 12, with the game being available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Metaphor: ReFantazio - Official Gallica Character Trailer

description: Check out the Reveal Trailer for Vignus, a top-down action-adventure roguelike strategy game developed by Codifyre. The Alpha Update 3 is available now for Alpha and Beta Kickstarter backers. A public demo is coming soon.
title: Autonomica - Official Alpha Update 3 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Frozen Trail Update Developer Overview Video for ARC Raiders, the hit third-person extraction shooter developed by Embark Studios. Players can hear from the development team about the major upcoming update, Frozen Trail, which brings players to a frigid region beyond the Rust Belt. Learn more about the massive downed Walker in the new Pendola Pass map, new ARCS to combat, and more to experience. The Frozen Trail Update for ARC Raiders is launching on October 8 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: ARC Raiders - Official Frozen Trail Update Developer Overview Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Worlds of Fire and Water DLC for Plan B: Terraform and the free Update 1.1 are out now on Steam. Check out the Plan B: Terraform trailer for the sci-fi planetary base-building sim game for another look at what to expect with the Worlds of Fire and Water DLC, and the free update 1.1. 

The Worlds of Fire and Water DLC features Fire World, with constant volcano eruptions, mineral-rich basalt, geysers and condensators. It also features Water World, with a few tiny islands a world covered in water, along with polluted water and filters. The free update 1.1 features a tech tree, ugrades, dynamic ice cap, shade and mirror satellites, ice comets, sea plants and plankton, water farm, small ship, airship, GHG neutralization factory, drone extractor, and floating extractor.
title: Plan B: Terraform - Official Worlds Of Fire And Water DLC Launch Trailer

#IGN #TheDivision2

author: GameTrailers
description:
In the third episode of Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Hour Zero, Cobra Kai’s Tamlyn Tomita is fighting to expose the truth in this live-action prequel to the upcoming game. 

Tomita plays a “news anchor silenced for telling the truth,” one of three strangers who survvive the opening days of the Republic of Sotoa's invasion of the Federation of Central Usea. 

The prequel sets the stage for the story that players will experience during the Campagin Mode of Ace Combat: Wings of Theve, which releases October 2. 

Tune in over the next two weeks to IGN.com and IGN's YouTube channel for the remianing episodes:

Now Streaming: Act 1
Now Straming: Act 2
Now Streaming: Act 3
Tuesday, September 29: Epilogue
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Hour Zero - Episode 3

description:
